doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source. held_fire.<dash|rmb|e|x|q|all>: {source, ours}: notes for the held-LMB rows (docs only: LMB is a held input everywhere, Hunter.trigger reads the key every frame and fire resumes the frame a slot's lock ends; --held-fire-resume-check). window.source: the footage evidence for the buffer window (DashFlow.BUFFER_S), shown in docs/heroes/dash_interactions.md. dash_jump.<ground|air|rise|same>: Space in a ground dash, Space in an air dash, Shift in a jump's rise, both on one step: {ours: cancel | both | ignore | end | buffer | dash (measured, --dash-jump-check), carry: share of the dash's speed kept, source, verdict: match | [?] (the source doesn't settle it)}.

lmb.source: data: Spin Dash dashes forward and hits round him; footage 0371: one hammer spin on arrival. The hammer is busy in the spin, so a throw, recall or swing goes when the dash ends (no footage of the pair)

rmb.source: data: Brightshield is a 0.1 s hold, nothing locks it out in the Spin Dash: the aegis rises mid-dash (Shift with it already up is the Shield Bash, see RMB -> dash)

e.source: data: Regen Field drops round the hammer wherever it is and doesn't move him, so it goes mid-dash (no footage of the pair)

x.source: data: Abyssalbreaker sends a fissure from where he stands; footage f25-f31: he is planted for the slam. It ends the dash where he is (no footage of the pair)

lmb.source: footage section 5: no air dash shown; as the ground dash, the hammer goes when the shove ends

rmb.source: no air dash in the footage; as the ground dash

e.source: no air dash in the footage; as the ground dash

x.source: no air dash in the footage; as the ground dash, the slam plants him where he is

lmb.source: wiki (Spin Dash): Shift while charging the Hammer Smash ends it in a short dash without the spin, on a reduced cooldown. Owner item 51 overrides the ending: the short plain dash goes on a full charge (with the charge kept the reduced cooldown has no reason left) and the swing keeps charging through it (hold.lmb.ground); in the swing's step or the perfect launch, Shift goes at once

rmb.source: data: Brightshield + Shift is the Shield Bash (6 s, its own cooldown), the shield briefly invulnerable; the aegis stays up through it

e.source: data: Regen Field stays round the hammer; the dash doesn't touch it

x.reason: planted for the wind-up and the slam (~0.6 s): a dash would move him off the plant
x.source: Owner item 48 (root only during the wind-up + slam, free after); footage f25-f31: Oath planted through the wind-up and slam. The data is silent on Shift in the cast. Shift pressed there goes the moment the plant ends; it is free while the lane erupts.

ground.source: Owner item 51 (supersedes item 30 and the wiki's Spin Dash ending the Hammer Smash): the swing keeps charging through the short plain dash and swings on the release, in the dash or after it

air.source: Owner item 51: the swing keeps charging through the air dash (the lumber); let go in it, it swings there and he keeps the lumber's momentum (a perfect one launches him on from where he is)

mantle.reason: owner item 30: a mantle ends the held Crushing Blow (item 51 keeps that)
mantle.source: Owner item 30; the source has no mantle rule.

all.source: Hero sheet bjorn.md:69: 'Hold to charge. Release swings.' No button-up rule anywhere in the data or footage.
all.ours: Another ability ends the Crushing Blow's hold with no swing; the key still down starts a fresh hold the step he is free (0 frames). Before: the button had to come up first (owner item 30's cancel rule), so a held LMB never came back after an RMB, E or glove.

window.source: Breaker (bjorn.md 0370-0372): the dash arrives in one frame with the spin on arrival; the footage has no dash into an ability, so the shared one-frame bound stands.

glide_rows.source: Owner rule, briefs/DECISIONS.md 2026-11-08: Shift cancels into glide instantly for every Hunter; glide opens only on a press, never a hold. Source rows for this dash: the air dash rows above.
glide_rows.ours: a fresh press ends the dash that step and the glider opens the next, keeping the dash speed up to the handoff cap. Asserted in --airdash-glide-check.

glide_rows.source: Not determinable: no source row for a glide pressed after this Hunter's abilities (data and footage silent). Kept: owner item 162b, no glider inside an ability's animation (docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.md).
glide_rows.ours: glide opens when the move's keys end, pressed after a tap: LMB 0.50 s; RMB n/a; E 0.95 s; X at once; Q at once (n/a: the press did not go off in the air in the check).

glide_rows.source: Not determinable: same as above. Kept: owner item 162b, a hold keeps the glider shut (Kael 113.2, Grimble bug 26 pattern stays).
glide_rows.ours: glide pressed 0.3 s into a hold: LMB n/a; RMB shut while held; E 0.68 s; X at once; Q at once.
